notes: §2002:12.3.4.12.2 SR2: data-name-1 and data-name-2 reference an alphanumeric or national item within a record of the file; all occurrences of data-name-2 are of one category. FileControlKeyRules screens it at every edition, the same rows as the 2023 text (word-identical), and a COBOL-2002 operand written subscripted (K(2), §2002:5.1.3) reaches the rows as the item the subscripts select (kb/Work PB5602).
